about: BOM line (catalogue SKU) -> the orderable maker part(s), with where each mapping was read. kind: distributor (priced live from Digi-Key / Mouser / element14), maker_direct (sold by the maker's own shop: price and lead time from the catalogue, flagged no_distributor), catalogue_house (McMaster / MISUMI). items[].qty_per: orderable units per BOM unit (feet per metre for wire sold by the foot, contacts per connector). design_change: true when the mapped part is not identical to what the design draws (the design must follow before it is buildable). Lines with no mapping, no real_parts.json record and no maker part number in the catalogue are placeholders (practice DG-07). Nothing here is from memory: each source is named.
